theme: Pointing a telescope that cannot be everywhere
title: Pointing a Telescope That Cannot Be Everywhere
strategies: value-first single-pass: sort targets by raw value descending and visit them in that order in pass 1 only, ignoring slew cost, cloud forecast, and pass 2 entirely (the trap this problem is built to punish)
input-order tiny plan: image only the first few targets as listed, no sorting or reasoning at all (weaker recipe baseline)

value-density routing with cloud-risk deferral: triage targets into pass-1/pass-2 pools using the forecast-vs-decay tradeoff, then greedily extend each pass's route by expected-value-per-slew-second so a cluster of cheap reliable targets beats a single expensive gamble
